title: Evidence: Serial Number Plate Concerns

attachments.platform_description: Macro photo of the camera bottom plate showing the serial number area. Scratch marks are visible around the edges of the serial number plate. The plate surface is not flush with the surrounding body panel.
attachments.title: Photo 1: Bottom Plate Close-Up

attachments.platform_description: Close-up of the screws near the serial number plate. One screw head shows tool marks and slight deformation of the slot.
attachments.title: Photo 2: Screw Comparison

attachments.platform_description: Screenshot of a Canon community forum thread about Canon EOS R6 Mark II serial number and origin concerns. Users in the thread report receiving cameras where the serial number validates in Canon's system but the unit displays non-US indicators on first boot, including Japanese menu labels and different firmware region settings.
attachments.title: Photo 3: Canon Community Forum Post

submitted_text:
When I first powered on the camera, the initial language selection included Japanese as the first option rather than English, which is unusual for a US-purchased unit. I've owned three Canon cameras purchased from authorized US dealers and all defaulted to English.
